verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no official client SDK for building against Open WebUI. It shows only personal API keys for calling the same REST endpoints the web UI uses (Bearer header), plus a dev-mode-only, experimental Swagger surface. Raw REST endpoints are developer building blocks, not an official SDK, and Python Functions are server-side plugins rather than client SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.
your scripts can do with a single `Authorization: Bearer` header.
